tool_args.rationale: The observed pilots span u_now and s_grad, and the task guidance explicitly states the initial five rows identify the three standard siphon parameters. Fit vmax, rho, and the open-sign local square-root branch coefficient numerically; observed gradients remain subcritical, so no threshold-avalanche term is included.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary both u_now and s_grad sufficiently to estimate the three base/branch parameters and determine the sign and magnitude of c_loc directly.
All observed s_grad values are at or below 2.2, below the stated 2.36 gray-zone trigger; no avalanche term is warranted.
The supplied signatures and shared-subtree guidance support the two-layer siphon base; the observed response does not provide evidence requiring a Haldane curve.
These do not resolve a remaining identifiable ambiguity in the stated three-parameter snapshot law and would add unnecessary cost.
